coverage: Primary-source snapshot reviewed 10 October 2026. Source-page checks detect fetch or text changes; they do not certify truth or discover all new announcements.
Source dates and reporting periods differ. Historical observations, announcements and planning inputs are kept separate.
No feature-level causal sales effect, willingness-to-pay estimate or verified implementation cost is available.
BMW Group history and model planning inputs have different populations. Do not combine them into market share.
Customer studies are a 2025 snapshot with different survey formats; they are not a preference time series.
Feature watchlist is editorial selection of documented developments, not a popularity ranking or exhaustive market census.

features.title: AI that understands the journey.
features.label: AI assistants
features.summary: Conversational assistants appear in multiple manufacturers’ roadmaps and products. Useful-task performance still needs to be measured.
features.question: Can a conversational interface complete useful driving tasks with less effort?

features.title: Less distraction. More control.
features.label: Cockpit usability
features.summary: Display innovation and usability assessment are moving together. A larger display alone is not evidence of a better experience.
features.question: Which common tasks could become clearer without adding driver distraction?

features.title: The car as an energy resource.
features.label: Bidirectional energy
features.summary: BMW’s German V2G offer connects a compatible vehicle to the electricity system. The commercial and technical prerequisites matter.
features.question: Would a local energy service create value after installation, tariff and battery constraints?

features.title: A vehicle that keeps evolving.
features.label: Software updates
features.summary: Mercedes-Benz documents vehicle software updates beyond infotainment. Support quality matters as much as update capability.
features.question: Which updates solve a customer problem, and how would BMW prove reliability?

features.title: Make charging part of the route.
features.label: Charging journeys
features.summary: Route planning with charging stops is a documented product capability. Regional infrastructure counts provide context, not experience quality.
features.question: Could clearer charging-stop information reduce uncertainty on real journeys?

features.title: Assistance people can trust.
features.label: Driver assistance
features.summary: Safety assessment increasingly considers how assistance behaves in everyday use. This is a rating direction, not a measure of feature popularity.
features.question: How could clearer alerts and calmer interventions improve trust in assistance?

features.title: Another way to replenish energy.
features.label: Battery swapping
features.summary: NIO reports substantial cumulative use of its swap network. It remains a distinct architecture and service model to investigate.
features.question: Is faster replenishment valuable enough to justify a different vehicle and network architecture?
